articles.summary: Backlog Value Up 28% Year over Year Aftermarket Revenue Growth of 65% Year over Year Reaffirms Fiscal Year 2026 Outlook Provided on October 19 CHICAGO, Nov. 09, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - FreightCar America, Inc. (NASDAQ: RAIL) (“FreightCar America” or the “Company”), a diversified manufacturer and supplier of railroad freight cars, railcar parts and components, today reported results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026. Third quarter results were consistent with the preliminary results the Company announced on October 19, 2026. Third Quarter 2026 Highlights Revenues of $76.5 million, compared to $160.5 million in the third quarter of 2025, with railcar deliveries of 662 units compared to 1,304 units in the prior year period Aftermarket revenues grew 65% year over year, reflecting continued organic growth in parts and components and the contribution from our recent acquisitions Gross margin of 8.8% with gross profit of $6.7 million, compared to gross margin of 15.1%
articles.title: FreightCar America, Inc. Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results
